label: Chat Message
description: Append one message to a chat history (or start a new one when no history is wired). The history is a typed value any chat-capable AI node consumes and re-emits, so a conversation is built by chaining this node and the AI calls; media attachments ride inside messages as stored files. Role 'tool' feeds a tool call's result back (wire the call's id to toolCallId).

inputs.name: history
inputs.description: The conversation so far. Unwired, this message starts a new history.

inputs.name: media
inputs.description: Media attached to this message: one stored image, audio clip, or video, or a list of them.

inputs.name: toolCallId
inputs.description: For role 'tool' only: the id of the tool call this message answers (from an LLM node's toolCalls output).

inputs.name: cacheBreakpoint
inputs.label: Cache up to here
inputs.description: Mark this message as a prompt-cache breakpoint: everything up to and including it is cached by providers that support it, and the next call reuses it. Put the stable part of a conversation (persona, reference material) before the mark and the volatile part after. A history carrying any mark of its own turns the LLM node's automatic marks off.
